data.long_meaning: The name Chuck is believed to be derived from the Old English word 'cuca,' meaning 'strong,' or 'cuc,' meaning 'free man.' In Norse mythology, Chuck is also associated with the god Thor, who was known for his strength and protection. The name Chuck carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Chuck usually hope their child will grow to embody free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
